subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw accept skill-authored configuration URLs in the Dashboard, and if so what typed action and URL policy should govern them?
rationale: The code change is straightforward, but deciding whether untrusted skill metadata may create clickable Dashboard actions crosses a product and security boundary that automation should not choose.

options.title: Adopt a typed config action
options.body: Add a bounded `metadata.openclaw` configuration-action shape with explicit URL validation, UI labeling, trust treatment, docs, and tests.

options.title: Reuse existing surfaces
options.body: Avoid new fields for now and express configuration entry points through `homepage`, Skill Cards, ClawHub metadata, or a future shared plugin settings surface.

options.title: Reject dashboard config links
options.body: Document that skills should not expose executable configuration URLs through core Dashboard metadata because the trust boundary is too broad.

recommendation.title: Adopt a typed config action
recommendation.body: Add a bounded `metadata.openclaw` configuration-action shape with explicit URL validation, UI labeling, trust treatment, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision most directly affects the Control UI Skills view and safe external URL behavior where recent history points to this owner.
